nodes.label: AMPM Platform Design Package
nodes.rationale: Drafts, version 0.2, 25 October 2026; nothing signed off. Split into Part A (written for AMPM, no technical background needed) and Part B (the developer drafts behind it) so the client can review and decide without reading the technical drafts. AMPM answered all 25 questions on 25 October 2026; the answers are applied to every draft (each opens with a 'Changes from AMPM's decisions' section) and stamped on every assumption; eleven points remain to confirm.

nodes.label: Part A: review package for AMPM
nodes.rationale: Written for AMPM and needs no technical background; each document says what AMPM should do with it (read, confirm, approve, answer, tick).

nodes.label: Part B: developer drafts
nodes.rationale: The technical drafts behind Part A, kept for reference rather than for AMPM to read.

nodes.label: Decision brief (review/decision-brief.md)
nodes.rationale: The short version: AMPM's answers under every question and the eleven points still to confirm.

nodes.label: Annotated brief (review/annotated-brief.md)
nodes.rationale: AMPM's five documents reproduced in full with every finding placed at the passage it concerns, so most findings take a sentence to understand.

nodes.label: Redesigned flowcharts (review/redesigned-flowcharts.md)
nodes.rationale: AMPM's two flowcharts and the customer journey as supplied and as upgraded; additions in green, changes in amber, so AMPM can approve the structure or mark boxes to change.

nodes.label: Open decisions (review/open-decisions.md)
nodes.rationale: The 25 questions in plain language with choices, what was assumed, and a box for the answer; the ten Tier 1 questions come first.

nodes.label: Assumptions taken (review/assumptions-taken.md)
nodes.rationale: Generated: every assumption made in place of an answer, grouped by theme, with a confirm column for AMPM to tick or correct.

nodes.label: Decision log (decision-log.md)
nodes.rationale: Generated: AMPM's answer to every question, what it does to each assumption, and the items still to confirm.

nodes.label: Requirements audit (requirements-audit.md)
nodes.rationale: The audit of the brief: 9 conflicts, 44 gaps, 15 ambiguities, 8 risks, 25 decisions; the question list lives in section 11, findings in sections 4 to 10.

nodes.label: Decision register (decision-register.md)
nodes.rationale: Generated: every assumption indexed by the question it depends on.

nodes.label: User flows (user-flows.md)
nodes.rationale: Twelve end-to-end flows with statuses, notifications and screens.

nodes.label: Wireframes (wireframes.md)
nodes.rationale: Screen-by-screen specification, 124 screens, with sketches; defines the screen identifiers.

nodes.label: Data model (data-model.md)
nodes.rationale: Entity-relationship model, 106 tables in 17 Mermaid diagrams; the diagrams are the source the field matrix is generated from.

nodes.label: Permission matrix (permission-matrix.md)
nodes.rationale: Roles, entitlements, visibility classes, transitions, audited actions.

nodes.label: Field matrix (field-matrix.md and field-matrix.csv)
nodes.rationale: Generated: every field with type, validation, editor, visibility, when required, automation.

nodes.label: Architecture (architecture.md)
nodes.rationale: Technology, hosting, security, backups, maintenance, integration plan.

nodes.label: Test cases (test-cases.md)
nodes.rationale: 36 acceptance criteria, 208 tests, phase exit packs, test data.

nodes.label: Milestone schedule and cost estimate
nodes.rationale: Not yet drafted: held until the platform question (Q1) and the volume question (Q15) are answered, because both drive the schedule and the cost.

nodes.label: Identifier scheme
nodes.rationale: Prefixes make every artefact traceable to the question it depends on: Q1-Q25 decisions only AMPM can make; CF/GP/AM/RK audit findings; A/P/T/U/W/V assumptions by draft; PUB/AUTH/DM/CP/TW/GR screens; AC-nn.m tests. This is what lets an answer propagate mechanically through the package.

nodes.label: Decision questions Q1 to Q25
nodes.rationale: A decision only AMPM can make; defined in Part A2 and A5 and requirements-audit.md section 11. All 25 answered on 25 October 2026.

nodes.label: Tier 1 questions
nodes.rationale: The ten questions AMPM should answer first.

nodes.label: Eleven points still to confirm
nodes.rationale: What remains open after AMPM's answers of 25 October 2026; listed in the decision log and the decision brief.

nodes.label: Audit findings (CF, GP, AM, RK)
nodes.rationale: Conflict, gap, ambiguity and risk findings from requirements-audit.md sections 4 to 10, placed in context in the annotated brief.

nodes.label: Assumption registers (A, P, T, U, W, V)
nodes.rationale: Assumptions made in place of an answer: data model (A), permissions (P), technology (T), flows (U), screens (W), testing (V); kept in section 0 of each developer draft and in Part A6. Each cites the question it depends on so it is confirmed or replaced when AMPM answers.

nodes.label: Screen identifiers (PUB, AUTH, DM, CP, TW, GR)
nodes.rationale: Public site, sign-in, demo, client portal, team workspace, guest RSVP portal; defined in wireframes.md.

nodes.label: Acceptance-criterion test cases (AC-nn.m)
nodes.rationale: Test cases under acceptance criterion nn; defined in test-cases.md.

nodes.label: Decision propagation chain
nodes.rationale: When AMPM answers a question: the assumption lines that cite it are confirmed or replaced; then the tables, screens and tests that cite those lines; then the generated files are rebuilt. Designed so a single answer flows through the whole package without hand edits.

nodes.label: Generated files policy
nodes.rationale: Generated files (field matrix, decision register, assumptions sheet, decision log, site pages) must not be edited by hand; they are rebuilt by the generators so the registers stay the single source.

nodes.label: field_matrix_build.py
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds field-matrix.md and field-matrix.csv from the diagrams in data-model.md and the rules in field_rules.py.

nodes.label: field_rules.py
nodes.rationale: The field rules the field matrix generator applies.

nodes.label: decision_register_build.py
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds decision-register.md from the assumption registers and the audit's question list.

nodes.label: assumptions_sheet_build.py
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds review/assumptions-taken.md from the assumption registers, grouped by theme.

nodes.label: apply_decisions.py
nodes.rationale: Stamps AMPM's decisions from decisions.json on every assumption register.

nodes.label: decision_log_build.py
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds decision-log.md after apply_decisions.py has run.

nodes.label: decisions.json
nodes.rationale: The machine-readable record of AMPM's decisions; edited when AMPM confirms a remaining point, then apply_decisions.py, decision_log_build.py and the three generators run.

nodes.label: site_build.mjs
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds site/index.html (the whole package as one shareable page) and with --brief site/brief.html; needs the marked npm package installed in docs/tools.

nodes.label: marked (npm package)
nodes.rationale: Markdown renderer site_build.mjs depends on; installed with npm install inside docs/tools.

nodes.label: site/index.html (shared page)
nodes.rationale: The whole package rendered as one shareable page.

nodes.label: site/brief.html (decision brief page)
nodes.rationale: The decision brief on its own, built with site_build.mjs --brief.

nodes.label: Published claude.ai artifact for AMPM
nodes.rationale: Private artifact https://claude.ai/artifact/55fJPFQnnqi8sVVU7FUFcv; republished after every rebuild so the link AMPM holds stays the same.

nodes.label: Mermaid diagrams
nodes.rationale: All diagrams are Mermaid so they render on GitHub, GitLab, VS Code (Mermaid preview extension), Obsidian and the shared page without an image pipeline.

nodes.label: app-ampm GitHub account
nodes.rationale: The project's own GitHub account; both repositories live under it and commit with its identity.

nodes.label: ampm-platform repository
nodes.rationale: Holds the design package, the audit, AMPM's source documents, the generators, and later the code.

nodes.label: ampm-vault repository
nodes.rationale: Holds the Obsidian vault in vault/, which the project repository ignores so the two histories stay separate.

nodes.label: Per-repository git identity
nodes.rationale: Both repositories carry the app-ampm identity and the credential helper so nothing committed is recorded under another account; checkpoint.sh and vault_sync.py refuse to commit when a repository has no identity of its own.

nodes.label: git-credential-ampm.sh
nodes.rationale: Credential helper that takes the app-ampm account's token from the GitHub CLI keyring whichever gh account is active.

nodes.label: setup_git.sh
nodes.rationale: After cloning, restores the git identity, the credential helper, the post-commit hook and the vault clone.

nodes.label: Obsidian vault (vault/)
nodes.rationale: Home.md is the hub; notes/ holds one note per question, assumption, finding and open item plus a log; docs/ and reference_docs/ are synced copies, so documents are edited in the project, not the vault, because the next sync overwrites the copy. Notes written in Obsidian are kept and committed. The vault is the human-readable record; the palace and the graph are what a session reads.

nodes.label: Session journal notes (notes/Sessions/)
nodes.rationale: One note per Claude Code session, created by the SessionStart hook and refreshed at the end of every turn with the requests made, the commits and the files changed; Claude writes the Narrative section at wrap-up.

nodes.label: Build decision records (notes/Build decisions/, D-nnn)
nodes.rationale: Technical and process decisions taken during the build (context, decision, alternatives, consequences), kept apart from AMPM's own answers under notes/Decisions/.

nodes.label: new_decision.py
nodes.rationale: Creates a D-nnn build decision record: python3 docs/tools/new_decision.py "Title" --area <area>.

nodes.label: AMPM Dashboard.base
nodes.rationale: Obsidian Bases file with live tables of open items, build decisions, sessions, AMPM's decisions, assumptions and findings, driven by the notes' properties, so it needs no generator.

nodes.label: session_journal.py
nodes.rationale: Run by the SessionStart hook with --start: creates the session's journal note and tells Claude where it is.

nodes.label: checkpoint.sh
nodes.rationale: Stop hook: commits and pushes the project if anything changed, then syncs the vault; shows a one-line message only when it committed. By hand: bash docs/tools/checkpoint.sh "message".

nodes.label: vault_sync.py
nodes.rationale: Post-commit hook: copies docs/ and reference_docs/ into the vault, rebuilds the generated notes, appends to the day's sync log note, commits and pushes the vault when something changed; --vault-only commits edits made inside Obsidian.

nodes.label: vault_build.py
nodes.rationale: Only rebuilds the vault notes.

nodes.label: launchd agent com.ampm.vault-sync
nodes.rationale: Runs vault_sync.py --vault-only every ten minutes so edits made inside Obsidian are committed and pushed; definition in docs/tools/; stop with launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.ampm.vault-sync.

nodes.label: memory_hook.sh
nodes.rationale: session-start: tells the session what the memory wing and the knowledge graph hold and whether the graph is stale; on Stop, PreCompact and SessionEnd mines the transcript into the MemPalace wing ampm in the background.

nodes.label: SessionStart hook
nodes.rationale: Runs session_journal.py --start and memory_hook.sh session-start at the start of every Claude Code session in this folder.

nodes.label: Stop hook
nodes.rationale: In .claude/settings.json: runs checkpoint.sh --hook and memory_hook.sh at the end of every Claude Code turn.

nodes.label: PreCompact and SessionEnd hooks
nodes.rationale: Run memory_hook.sh before compaction and at session end so the transcript is mined before it is lost.

nodes.label: post-commit hook
nodes.rationale: Installed by setup_git.sh; runs vault_sync.py on every project commit.

nodes.label: graphify hook-guard (PreToolUse hook)
nodes.rationale: Installed by graphify install --project; before every search or file read points the session at the knowledge graph instead of grepping when the graph can answer.

nodes.label: .claude/settings.json
nodes.rationale: Committed; holds the project hooks.

nodes.label: .mcp.json
nodes.rationale: Committed; the two MCP servers (mempalace and graphify), approved once per machine when Claude Code asks.

nodes.label: .graphifyignore
nodes.rationale: Committed; generated tables and tooling are left out of the graph.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md
nodes.rationale: Committed; the rules every session follows.

nodes.label: /graphify skill (.claude/skills/graphify/)
nodes.rationale: Committed; /graphify . builds or rebuilds the graph, /graphify . --update refreshes changed files.

nodes.label: graphify-out/ (knowledge graph)
nodes.rationale: A knowledge graph of the design package, the generators and AMPM's source documents: concepts, screens, flows, decisions and the edges between them, each tagged extracted or inferred. Committed with its report, extraction cache and manifest so a fresh worktree queries the same graph without rebuilding.

nodes.label: MemPalace 3.11
nodes.rationale: Local palace in ~/.mempalace; verbatim text, semantic search, no API calls. Used via mempalace search / wake-up --wing ampm and the mempalace MCP server (palace_query, palace_exec). The palace itself is not committed and stays on the machine.

nodes.label: MemPalace wing ampm
nodes.rationale: Holds the transcript of every session run in this folder or its worktrees, and the design docs.

nodes.label: MemPalace shared wing wing_api
nodes.rationale: The unnamed shared wing MemPalace's own global shell hooks file running transcripts under.

nodes.label: graphify 0.9
nodes.rationale: Query with graphify query, explain, path; graphify-out/graph.html in a browser; the graphify MCP server.

nodes.label: MemPalace global shell hooks caveat
nodes.rationale: MemPalace's own shell hooks (mempal_save_hook.sh, mempal_precompact_hook.sh in ~/.claude/settings.json) file a running session's transcript under the shared wing wing_api without naming the project; because MemPalace keys drawers by content and upserts, they overwrite the wing the project hooks set. Fix: point them at the project-aware runner (mempalace hook run --hook stop --harness claude-code, and --hook precompact) and re-key the shared wing with mempalace wings split --wing wing_api (plan, then --yes, then mempalace hallways --rebuild). Done on the development Mac on 26 October 2026.

nodes.label: setup_memory.sh
nodes.rationale: On a new machine installs MemPalace and graphify at the tested versions with uv tool install, backfills the wing with the project's transcripts and docs, and prints the shell-hooks reminder when it finds them.

nodes.label: Recording a confirmation from AMPM
nodes.rationale: Open-item and log notes are written once and kept, so a confirmation is recorded in the open item's note (status: confirmed), then docs/decisions.json is updated, then apply_decisions.py, decision_log_build.py, decision_register_build.py, assumptions_sheet_build.py, vault_build.py and site_build.mjs (with --brief) run and the two shared pages are republished; the next checkpoint commits everything and the vault follows.

nodes.label: reference_docs/ (AMPM source documents)
nodes.rationale: The brief AMPM supplied: the business explanation, the Why AMPM App note, the Developer Technical Specification v1.0, two Level-1 flowcharts, and AMPM's answers of 25 October 2026 in answers/.

nodes.label: AMPM (client)
nodes.rationale: The wedding-platform client; the only party who can answer Q1 to Q25.

nodes.label: ~/Library/Logs/ampm-vault-sync.log
nodes.rationale: Where the checkpoint and the vault sync log.

nodes.label: ~/Library/Logs/ampm-memory-hooks.log
nodes.rationale: Where the memory hooks log.
